text_block_list.text: Silence Suzuka brilliantly produced results during her "first 3 years" in the Twinkle Series.

On a peaceful day,
after reaching that milestone—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (—Spe-chan. Hehe, what a serious look on her face...)
Silence Suzuka had come to watch Special Week's mock race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Tomorrow's mock race?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Actually, El and
Grass are running in it too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If I can beat both of them, there's
something I want to tell Suzuka-san...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: (What's with the sudden formality now, I wonder...)

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Well if it isn't Suzuka.
It's rare to see you just watching a race.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove.
Well, you see, Spe-chan invited me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: And you?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
A few of the girls I've been training recently are running today,
so I came to watch.

Air Groove narrowed her eyes
and gazed at the Umamusume lining up in the starting gates.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: —Come to think of it, lately there are a lot of girls who look up to you.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Is that so?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's frustrating, but...
I understand how you feel too.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Racing across the turf like a swift gale,
accelerating even further on the final stretch...
That's not something you see every day.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I told you before that you're a "beacon of light"
for the juniors, but—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, even to me back then...
you were one of my "lights."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Air Groove.
(CLUNK!)

—Cutting through the air,
the starting signal for the race echoed out.
The Umamusume burst out of the gates all at once and charge down the track.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
What I just told you...
please keep it to yourself, alright?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Understood.

Mock race or not, a contest is a contest.
Nobody looked like they were holding back.

—Special Week positioned herself
at the rear of the pack, biding her time.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan......
The race proceeded under palpable tension—and eventually approached the 4th corner.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAAAAGH!!

With a burst of spirit,
Special Week accelerated.

Her acceleration carried her past one runner after another,
and eventually—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: All three are side-by-side...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I will not lose death...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaahー!

Grass Wonder, El Condor Pasa,
and Special Week are—
At the exact same moment, they surged across the finish line...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Suzuka-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan...! Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
And, um...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I will surpass Suzuka-san!

She blinks in surprise at the sudden declaration.
Air Groove bursts out laughing.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Special Week, if you have something to say, don't panic and speak calmly in order.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huh, ah, I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Um, well...
Do you remember the night of the Mainichi Okan...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes. Of course.
It was the night when Special Week's desire shifted... from wanting to "chase after" Silence Suzuka, to wanting to "surpass" her.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ever since then, I've been doing my best with that in mind, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Still, whenever I try to puff out my chest and tell Suzuka-san, "I'm going to pass you!"—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Somewhere in my heart... I might've been wondering,
"Can I really overtake them?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...To begin with,
even El-chan and Grass-chan
were "two incredible people" in my eyes."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still... just standing around thinking it's amazing
isn't gonna cut it, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Especially if I want to surpass Suzuka-san...

The late charge she displayed in the mock race—
and the true meaning behind the spirit she poured into it.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...So that was what it was all about.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
“—Today, I finally stood alongside those two.
That's why I can say it with my head held high.”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I will... surpass Suzuka-san!
I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes... I understand...!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Looks like a new rival has been born, Suzuka.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—You're right.
It's not over yet.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Spe-chan.
However... I'm not giving up the lead.
—That night.
I call out to her as she stands alone.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Ah... Good work.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
No, just because...
I felt like looking at the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Spe-chan declared war on me today.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Fufu, I'm... so happy.
Knowing that something new is about to begin right away.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm sure that beyond competing with her,
and even beyond that...
there's something new waiting for me...

As she gazed out at the dark grounds, her eyes
sparkled, brimming with anticipation.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It feels like so much has happened
since coming here...

About three years have passed since I met Silence Suzuka...
It hasn't always been smooth sailing.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Going forward...
it might not always be smooth sailing."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
There may be times when you lose your way again.
Even so—
choice_data_list: (Still—if it's her, I know she can.)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I feel like as long as you're with me, Trainer,
everything will be alright.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Just as it has always been.
Saying so, she gave a gentle smile.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"I look forward to continuing to work with you,
Trainer."
